name: agent-fleet
description: Agent Fleet: local-first multi-agent orchestration and observability

scripts.setup: pnpm install && uv sync --directory apps/backend && uv run --directory apps/backend agent-fleet-db upgrade
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,runner,web -c magenta,blue,green "pnpm dev:api" "pnpm dev:runner" "pnpm dev:web"
scripts.lint: uv run --directory apps/backend ruff check agent_fleet tests && pnpm --filter @agent-fleet/web lint
scripts.typecheck: uv run --directory apps/backend mypy && pnpm --filter @agent-fleet/web typecheck
